# ComplyEasyAI

> ComplyEasyAI (also written "ComplyEasy AI") is an AI compliance automation platform.
> Read-only integrations collect audit evidence continuously, agents monitor controls and
> propose fixes with human approval for high-impact changes, and each control is mapped once
> across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and the EU AI Act.

Frameworks listed are standards the platform helps customers prepare for, not certifications
held by ComplyEasyAI. Pricing is quoted per framework mix (four annual plans; see /pricing).
Last updated: 2026-09-27

## Product

- [Home](https://www.complyeasyai.com/): what ComplyEasyAI does, on one page.
- [Platform](https://www.complyeasyai.com/platform): the aCOS loop (observe, predict, act, verify, learn), the Compliance Digital Twin and safe remediation.
- [Pricing](https://www.complyeasyai.com/pricing): Foundation, Essentials, Growth and Visionary plans.
- [Frameworks](https://www.complyeasyai.com/frameworks): all 16 framework guides.
- [FAQ](https://www.complyeasyai.com/faq): pricing, frameworks, AI, security, integrations and support.
- [Book a demo](https://www.complyeasyai.com/demo): a 30-minute walkthrough tailored to your frameworks.

- [EU AI Act](https://www.complyeasyai.com/eu-ai-act) · [NIST AI RMF](https://www.complyeasyai.com/nist-ai-rmf) · [ISO/IEC 42001](https://www.complyeasyai.com/iso-42001) · [AIUC-1](https://www.complyeasyai.com/aiuc-1)
